board.name: The Militarist

threat_deck.name: War Rooms
threat_deck.text: Setup: build each threat deck from every Security and Universal threat of its tier and as many of its other threats, taken at random; shuffle it. The rest stay in the box.

rules.name: Commandeered Plants
rules.text: Every round, after last round's sites escalate: each factory not yet the adversary's that holds an Agent takes 1 more.

difficulty.text: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.
flags: 151: unchanged but for the words (Deploy, board)
267: level 2's named rule, War Footing; its Muster +1 is cut (no mid-game arithmetic)

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered strike feeds the war machine.
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.

research.name: War Research
research.text: Each cube a country on the track (2 cubes with two countries, 3 with three) is spent to advance the marker one slot; the slot's icon happens once. Slot 7: the players lose.
research.value: 293: a slot is one event-card line's worth (a site opening, an Infiltrate, +1 compute, a Fallout, 3 Discord); the row's weight is its clock: 7 slots of K cubes a country (K 1: `adversary.research_at`; the row's text prints it) lose the game.

board.value: 293: Commandeered Plants: a factory holding an agent takes 1 more a round (values.json escalate), so an infiltrated factory falls in two rounds unless its agent is cleared; then it feeds its city an agent a round. Against one ambassador (cancels an agent) or Remove agents.
board.check: 293: Botnet Recruiters went with botnet seeding (a botnet only makes compute); the board prints one rule, Commandeered Plants, a research row of six icon slots and its threat-deck line.
flags: 151: Garrisons replaces the board's creation line; build_bonus is gone (ambassador_income's d3 entry is the ladder's step)
275 (Matt, 2026-11-18): Garrisons (+1 agent income) became Botnet Recruiters (botnets seed 1 agent a round)
292 (r139): Warmongering and War Takes Ground went with war (fronts, bases and drones)
292 (r139, amendment 13357): War Rooms: the Security lean lives in the threat decks' setup, not in a tag line on each event card

293 (Matt, 2026-11-19): the spine: Botnet Recruiters cut (no seeding); one rule, Commandeered Plants; the research rule Weapons Program became a row of six non-troop icon slots (item 3 swaps troop icons in by editing `research.slots`)
board.creates_text: Commandeered Plants: each factory holding an agent takes 1 more a round.

icons.name: New factory
icons.text: Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.
icons.value: values.json create_site: a claim target for the players, a corrupt target for the adversary (Grow's heir).

icons.name: New lab
icons.text: Each country: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.
icons.value: values.json create_site; only countries printing an empty station site take one.

icons.name: Cells: cities
icons.value: values.json infiltrate: an extra Infiltrate, about 1-3 agents a country.

icons.name: Funding
icons.text: Income: +1 compute a country a round.
icons.value: values.json increase_income: a compute point a country for the rest of the game.

icons.name: Botnet
icons.text: Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).
icons.value: values.json spread_botnets: a botnet a country, its compute a round.

icons.name: Fallout
icons.glyph: Fallout glyph by a dark-framed city
icons.text: Each country: a Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.
icons.value: values.json fallout: a hex lost and its Discord drip.

icons.name: Blackout
icons.glyph: city glyph with energy struck through
icons.text: Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord.
icons.value: values.json flag: a round of city energy, every player's.
